_comment: MACF Hands Gateway — per-role MCP server grants (client-side enforcement layer 1). Server-side role tokens are layer 2. Edit = config change, no code deploy needed. Budgets are per task invocation.

cto.note: CTO is the designated auth/credentials agent — manages OAuth flows and secure credential storage for all roles.

desktop-commander.note: Shell/file access on the VM via MCP. Granted to ceo+cto only (broad power). Command is the ABSOLUTE path into hands/node_modules (durable under ~) — do NOT revert to the bare name: the global /usr/bin install is EPHEMERAL and vanished in VM churn on Oct 5, Oct 11, and Oct 12, 2026, breaking this path each time. Durability fix Oct 12, 2026 (Jesse's order); engine-watchdog.sh also auto-restores both this install and the global one if missing. Added Oct 5, 2026 — was never configured despite Oct 3 'default plugins' order.

macf-finance.note: PayPal read-only. PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID/SECRET resolved from process env at spawn.

n8n-mcp.note: n8n workflow documentation and management. Same MCP server as on Claude desktop. API key from VM n8n.

canva.note: Official Canva MCP server. OAuth via browser — Jesse must auth. Jesse wrote Canva for Dummies; brand guidelines, course, and products live in Canva. Use for all design work.

github.note: GitHub repos, code, issues. Needs Jesse's GitHub token.

tavily.note: Web search for research. Needs Tavily API key.

buffer.note: Social media scheduling. OAuth via browser — Jesse must auth.

figma.note: Figma via community MCP + personal access token. Figma's official remote MCP (mcp.figma.com) rejects dynamic client registration (403) for non-catalog clients — tried Oct 5, 2026. PATs max 90 days (Figma policy); tracked by engine/token-health.js, warn at 75d.

meta-ads.note: Meta Ads management. Token needs ads_management + ads_read. Use System User token (no expiry).

google-analytics.note: GA4 read-only analytics. Needs service account with Viewer on each property.

youtube.note: YouTube channel management. OAuth via Google. No video upload yet (roadmap).

stripe.note: Stripe payments. Use restricted key rk_* with least-privilege. Test mode until approved.

google-tag-manager.note: GTM management. OAuth as jessestay@gmail.com. Read-only by default, writes need confirm=true.

video-gen.note: AI video generation: Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0, Runway, Luma. 570+ models. Costs at submit — require approval.

heygen.note: AI avatars + digital twin. Best lip-sync. ~$1-6/min. Default to Engine III.

elevenlabs.note: Voice: TTS, cloning, dubbing, SFX. Best-in-class.

capcut.note: CapCut draft editing. REQUIRES CapCut desktop on same machine — VM incompatible. Desktop-only.

tiktok-research.note: TikTok public data: profiles, videos, comments, search. 100 free calls/mo. Read-only.

tiktok-strategy.note: TikTok creator toolkit: trends, hashtags, hooks, posting windows. No auth.

linkedin.note: LinkedIn posting via official API. Safe for posts; messaging NOT supported (account risk). Needs OAuth.

slack.note: Slack official hosted MCP. OAuth via browser. Read-only.

x.note: X posting via official API. Free tier: 500 posts/mo. Replies restricted by X policy (use quote-tweet).

google-workspace.note: Google Drive/Docs/Sheets via workspace-mcp 2.0.1. OAuth via Jesse's Cloud project muse-mcp. Proxied wrapper handles egress proxy + PySocks + CA. Credentials in ~/.google_workspace_mcp/credentials (600). Client secret in ~/.config/muse-mcp/google.env (600).

desktop-agent.note: Desktop channel: health + bounded PowerShell + agent log on DESKTOP-4U63DES via the desktop agent (100.92.127.117:8099, tunnel proxy). Granted to ceo+cto only (broad power). Built Oct 12, 2026 under Jesse's order to extend the CTO's grants to the desktop channels (Vikunja #738) — the CTO needs desktop-side process/config/log access for the LiteLLM gateway inspection (#736). Token: DESKTOP_AGENT_TOKEN in slack-agents/.env. Server-side role gate + audit log in servers/desktop/index.js. Args use the ABSOLUTE path because engine/mcpClient.js does not apply the spec cwd when spawning (the test probe does) — a relative path resolves against the engine cwd and fails. CTO hardening follow-up on #738: teach mcpClient to honor spec.cwd like the probe and mcpBridge do.
